summary:
Plan of w138 (supervision r72-r74) written to plan.md.
r72: a new module, scripts/supervise_draft.py, drafts one work-item per capability that a formulated proposal's adds/changes name. It skips a capability that already has a work-item part of the proposal (r72's 'one'), and drafting runs before the pull so the drafts are delivered in the same run (r1).
r73: deprecated scenarios are read from features/<under>.feature by their own tags and written as bullets under ## Retires. A draft with nothing to retire gets no section.
r74: the fix-now findings are the kept review's result.json questions; findings.md is not parsed (worker-results-are-files). One fix work-item is drafted for the last kept review that no work-item names yet. It takes part_of, under and accepts from the work-item the findings concern, and gets a findings: field (review-of-work-items).
Drafting calls workqueue.add in-process with new keyword parameters (no new CLI options) and pushes afterwards (r38). Run.run goes back to the pull after a fix draft.
Tests broken: none (positional add callers kept; existing reviewers list no questions).
Open cases: findings spanning several proposals, a reviewer that lists findings at every review, a failed push after a draft, a missing review result.
